name: Pantry Staples System
description: Builds a complete pantry staples inventory organized by cuisine type, with rotation schedules, storage guidelines, and a restocking system. Covers core dry goods, canned essentials, oils, vinegars, spices, and condiments that enable cooking any weeknight meal without a special grocery trip. Use when the user asks about stocking a pantry, essential ingredients to keep on hand, building a spice collection, or creating a pantry restocking routine. Do NOT use for meal planning (use meal-prep-workflow), recipe-specific ingredient lists, or food storage safety (use food-storage-safety).
